dedupe_keys.name: global 10 m industrial land maps for 1 093 large cities 2017 2023 hong kong polytechnic university

description: Annual 10 m maps of industrial land inside 1,093 large cities worldwide from 2017 to 2023. The Zenodo record says each GeoTIFF (WGS84) has three classes, industrial land in built-up areas, non-industrial built-up land and non-built-up areas, with files named by country code, city ID and year; a city table gives names, countries, urban ecoregion, modelling cluster and annual industrial land area per capita, and a validation package is included. The GEE Community Catalog page says the maps cover cities of 100 km² or more, were made by machine learning on Sentinel-2 reflectance, night-time lights and OpenStreetMap, reach an overall accuracy of 91.87% to 92.21%, and are also served in Google Earth Engine. The Zenodo record (7 February 2025) holds nine files, about 3.2 GB, free to download under CC BY 4.0, while the catalog page lists a Creative Commons non-commercial licence. Coverage is urban areas worldwide. Caveats: large cities only, and the two licence statements differ. For simulation it shows where industrial land sits in cities, to place factories and warehouses in flood and heat exposure models when facility lists are missing. A related catalogue record is the remote sensing industrial land map for China.
